subject.title: fix(feishu): retry once on token-invalid errors 99991663/99991664 with cache invalidation (fixes #97287)

question: Should invalid-token recovery be narrowed to the failing Feishu account/appId before this PR becomes the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97287?
rationale: Source inspection establishes that the current registry invalidates all Feishu accounts, but only the Feishu owner can confirm whether that broader blast radius is intentional and choose between the competing implementation candidates.

options.title: Narrow and land this PR
options.body: Pass account/appId scope through the retry path, clear only the affected SDK and CardKit caches, add multi-account isolation coverage, refresh exact-head checks, and use this PR as the canonical fix.

options.title: Accept process-wide invalidation
options.body: Document that any invalid token intentionally refreshes every Feishu account, add concurrent multi-account proof, refresh exact-head checks, and land this PR with the wider operational cost understood.

options.title: Pause for another candidate
options.body: Keep this PR open while selecting another implementation, but require equivalent ordinary-send coverage and positive real behavior proof before treating that candidate as canonical.

recommendation.title: Narrow and land this PR
recommendation.body: Pass account/appId scope through the retry path, clear only the affected SDK and CardKit caches, add multi-account isolation coverage, refresh exact-head checks, and use this PR as the canonical fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata identifies @m1heng as the Feishu community owner, making them the strongest available owner for the cache-scope and canonical-candidate decision.
